question: Which revolution followed the Green Revolution in India, focusing on increasing the production of fruits and vegetables?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Golden Revolution**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Golden Revolution** in India refers to the period when significant emphasis was placed on increasing the production of **fruits, vegetables, honey, and horticultural crops**.
 
• This revolution was crucial for enhancing **agricultural diversification** and boosting the economy through **horticultural advancements**.
 
• The term is associated with the time frame between the **1991–2003** due to focused policies and investments in horticulture.
 
• It played a vital role in improving the **quality of nutrition** and food security in the country.
 
• The revolution was driven by the efforts of **agricultural scientists, government initiatives, and collaboration with farmers**.
 
• Horticulture crops like fruits, vegetables, flowers, nuts, spices, and honey witnessed remarkable growth during this period.
 
• The **National Horticulture Mission (NHM)**, launched in 2005, further accelerated the benefits of the Golden Revolution.
 
• This revolution contributed to the enhancement of **income generation** for farmers by promoting high-value crops.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **White Revolution**__

 __
 
• The **White Revolution** refers to the period of increased milk production in India, making the country the largest producer of milk in the world.
 
• This revolution was spearheaded by **Dr. Verghese Kurien**, known as the 'Father of the White Revolution'.
 
• The **Operation Flood program**, launched in 1970 by the **National Dairy Development Board (NDDB)**, played a pivotal role.
 
• It helped in achieving self-sufficiency in dairy production and improved the livelihood of millions of rural farmers.
 
 
 
• **Blue Revolution**__
 __
 
• The **Blue Revolution** is associated with the growth of **aquaculture and fisheries** in India.
 
• It focused on enhancing fish production and sustainable management of aquatic resources.
 
• The revolution contributed significantly to **food security and employment generation** in coastal regions.
 
• Government schemes like the **National Fisheries Development Board (NFDB)** have supported this initiative.
 
 
 
• **Yellow Revolution**__
 
 
• The **Yellow Revolution** refers to the increase in the production of **oilseeds** in India.
 
• This revolution was aimed at achieving self-sufficiency in edible oil production.
 
• It was primarily driven by the **Technology Mission on Oilseeds**, launched in 1986.
 
• The focus was on crops like **mustard, sunflower, and soybean**.
